# User security information outline

<!-- clause: 1 -->
## Manufacturer identity and contact

- Manufacturer name and trading name: Example Ltd, trading as Example Home.
- Postal address, e-mail address and website: 1 Example Street, Exampletown; info@example.com; https://example.com

<!-- clause: 2 -->
## Contact point for vulnerability reports

- Where to report a vulnerability (e-mail, web form or URL): security@example.com
- Link to the coordinated disclosure policy: https://example.com/security/disclosure

<!-- clause: 3 -->
## Product identification

- Product name, type, model and version: Example Thermostat, connected thermostat, model T2, firmware 2.4.
- Batch or serial number scheme: serial number ET2-YYWW-nnnn printed on the base.

<!-- clause: 4 -->
## Intended purpose

- What the product is for and its security properties: the intended purpose is home heating control; it is designed with encrypted traffic and signed updates.
- Intended users and environment: householders, with operating conditions of a home network.

<!-- clause: 5 -->
## Known risks and misuse

- Circumstances that can lead to significant cybersecurity risks: use on an open public network or with the default code left unchanged.
- Foreseeable misuse: sharing the pairing code with third parties.

<!-- clause: 6 -->
## Where the declaration of conformity can be found

- Web address of the EU declaration of conformity: https://example.com/doc

<!-- clause: 7 -->
## Support and end date

- Type of security update support offered: automatic over-the-air security updates.
- End date of support: 2031-03-01

<!-- clause: 8 -->
## Secure use from set-up to decommissioning

- Secure set-up and default settings: change the pairing code at first start; remote access is off by default.
- Installing updates and secure operation: keep automatic updates on.
- Safe decommissioning and data removal: use factory reset in settings before resale or disposal.

<!-- clause: 9 -->
## Location of the bill of materials

- Where the software bill of materials can be obtained, if offered: on request from security@example.com.
